title: Remove Internet Identity flow and fix admin signup provisioning

requirements.text: Ensure the app uses only local-session authentication in the user experience (no Internet Identity login prompts/redirects), and remove any remaining Internet Identity-dependent auth flow from non-immutable frontend code paths.

quotes: rebuild now with Internet Identity fully removed and only local session login active

acceptanceCriteria: A new user can sign in using the existing local session sign-in flow (Ed25519 local identity) and can reach the app without any Internet Identity UI.
No routes or screens require Internet Identity to proceed (local-session auth is sufficient).
No frontend components/routes import or depend on the Internet Identity hooks for user sign-in/sign-out in the active flow (outside immutable platform files).

requirements.text: Update backend admin provisioning logic so that the admin usernames "sayedbaquar" and "bharatnikam" are recognized as admins, and fix the current mismatch that prevents successful admin creation/approval due to the hardcoded allowlist values ("Admin Name1", "Admin Name2").
acceptanceCriteria: After signing up with username "sayedbaquar", the account is treated as an admin by backend role checks (e.g., admin-only queries/mutations succeed once the user is authorized as admin in access control).

After signing up with username "bharatnikam", the account is treated as an admin by backend role checks (e.g., admin-only queries/mutations succeed once the user is authorized as admin in access control).
Admin recognition no longer depends on the placeholder allowlist entries "Admin Name1" and "Admin Name2" causing admin signup failures.

requirements.text: Set the backend admin signup password to exactly "Hans@987123" and ensure it applies to all admin accounts (including "sayedbaquar" and "bharatnikam") wherever the admin signup password is still used.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting admin signup with password "Hans@987123" succeeds for admin-eligible accounts.
Attempting admin signup with an incorrect password fails with a clear error (if password gating remains enabled).

requirements.text: Remove the "admin special password" requirement from the admin signup UX and backend gate so that admin-eligible users are not blocked by an extra special-password step during signup.

quotes: also remove admin special password requirement

acceptanceCriteria: In the signup UI, selecting "Admin" does not require entering an additional admin signup password field.
Backend admin signup for admin-eligible users does not fail due to a missing/incorrect special password requirement.
A user who signs up as an admin-eligible username can access the admin area ("/admin/users") once their admin role is established by the backend access control flow.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Keep all Motoko backend logic in the single actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade requires state migration.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only local-session auth is in scope).
Introducing external databases or additional backend services.
